issue.title: Per-note ready cap: gesture feedback (picker pills and capacity notices)
issue.description:
Deferred phase of epic bob-cli-3f (per-note Ready cap). The accepted design is the
"Deferred: gesture feedback after the freshness trial" section of
plan:202610/per_note_ready_cap.md — plan first (size large) against the code as it
stands when this starts, using that section as the design.

Scope, in short (the plan section is authoritative):

- bob-ledger-tools `api.noteReady` additions (namespace stays v1): `countedRows(path, rows)`,
  `change(before, after)` (warn when after > cap and worsening; progress ▼k or
  `✓ back to cap/cap`), `chips(results)`, and `watch(paths)` receipts.
- bob-navigation-hotkeys Ctrl+Shift+M picker: per-row capacity pills (`3/5`,
  `5/5 full`, red `11/5 +6`, `no cap`) and a `5/5 → 6/5` projection on the
  highlighted row, from one snapshot taken when the picker opens.
- Capacity chips on existing Bob command notices: Ctrl+Shift+M move card,
  Alt+N release and the lane row, Ctrl+Shift+P rolls/cancel/dependsOn/Ctrl+D/Blocked
  recovery, create-project-from-task and convert-note-to-task, and task-status-cycler
  `watch` receipts (standalone notice only for warn or `✓ back to cap`).
- Noise rules, the N1–N8 rule vectors, and the release/keep-rule steps from the plan.
  Close vault task `bob_gtd#^prj-task-count-warn` once verified.

What already shipped (bob-cli-3f): `bob ready`, `api.noteReady` v1 read API
(bob-ledger-tools 1.15.0+), the dash CROWDED chip, crowded.md, the `bob-ready-notes`
block, and the `## Tasks` heading chips.

task_type_fields.proposal: Ctrl+Shift+M picker capacity pills and capacity chips in Bob command notices (move, release, priority/schedule/cancel/dependsOn, cycler receipts), backed by additive api.noteReady countedRows/change/chips/watch members, per the "Deferred: gesture feedback after the freshness trial" section of plan:202610/per_note_ready_cap.md.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: Epic bob-cli-3f shipped only the read-only per-note Ready cap surfaces. Its accepted plan deliberately defers the notice work until after the freshness trial and the sase.md triage, so a routine bob plugins sync cannot deploy it early.

issue.creation_reason: Epic bob-cli-3f's plan defers gesture feedback until after the 2026-10-05 → 2026-10-18 freshness trial and one sase.md triage session (vault task under bob_gtd#^prj-task-count-warn); SASE cannot defer an epic phase to a date, so its land agent files it as a snoozed task.
